description: The figure is a grouped bar chart illustrating quality score values for three methods (IFD, TagNum, and DEITA) measured on two score types (object-related and subject-related), with horizontal reference lines indicating corresponding base averages. The horizontal axis contains the categories and is labeled “Quality Scores,” with the three category labels ordered left to right as IFD, TagNum, and DEITA; the vertical axis is labeled “Scores” and uses a linear scale spanning roughly 30 to 70, with regularly spaced tick labels at 5-unit intervals. Each category has two adjacent vertical bars: a light blue bar for “Avg$_{obj}$” and a light salmon/pink bar for “Avg$_{sub}$,” with numeric value labels above each bar. For IFD, the Avg$_{obj}$ bar is labeled 63.98 and the Avg$_{sub}$ bar is labeled 41.90; for TagNum, the Avg$_{obj}$ bar is 66.06 and the Avg$_{sub}$ bar is 39.13; for DEITA, the Avg$_{obj}$ bar is 67.64 and the Avg$_{sub}$ bar is 42.99. Two dashed horizontal lines provide baselines: a blue dashed line labeled “Base Avg$_{obj}$” at 64.71 and an orange dashed line labeled “Base Avg$_{sub}$” at 37.91. The bars are grouped by category with the Avg$_{obj}$ bar consistently positioned to the left of the Avg$_{sub}$ bar within each group, and there is no additional visual emphasis beyond the value annotations and the dashed baseline lines.
